The following screenshot shows the results of a query that returns 1,000 email events. The
timeline is unfiltered, so it displays the full range of results with a timestamp for each day.
Select a day or range of days to filter the results for that time period.
You can split the results in the timeline by any column that has at least two but less than 50
unique values.
The following screenshot shows the results of a query that returns 1,000 email events. The
timeline is ungrouped, so it displays all the results in a single line.
